topics.title: Strings, Hashes, Lists, Sets & Sorted Sets (ZSet)
topics.objective: Map application state to optimal Redis in-memory primitives for O(1) and O(log N) operations.
topics.exercise: Build a real-time gaming leaderboard using Redis Sorted Sets with rank query support.

topics.title: TTL Expirations & Memory Eviction Policies
topics.objective: Prevent out-of-memory errors by sizing caches with appropriate allkeys-lru or volatile-ttl policies.
topics.exercise: Configure a Redis test instance to verify LRU eviction under memory saturation.

topics.title: Distributed Locking (Redlock Algorithm)
topics.objective: Coordinate shared resource access across multi-instance microservices without race conditions.
topics.exercise: Implement a distributed lock manager with safe Lua script release verification.

topics.title: Pub/Sub Messaging & Redis Streams (XADD, XREADGROUP)
topics.objective: Process real-time event streams with persistent consumer groups and ack confirmations.
topics.example: XADD stream:orders * order_id 101 user 42; XREADGROUP GROUP mygroup ...
topics.exercise: Build an event worker pool consuming orders from a Redis Stream with consumer recovery on restart.

topics.title: Persistence (RDB/AOF), Sentinel & Cluster Sharding
topics.objective: Ensure durability and high availability across automated master failovers and 16,384 hash slots.
topics.example: appendonly yes; appendfsync everysec; cluster-enabled yes;
topics.exercise: Configure Redis Sentinel to execute automated master promotion during primary node failure simulation.
